Title: Measure before you optimise
Body: Record a performance profile or run Lighthouse first. The slow part is rarely where you expect, and a measured baseline proves the fix worked.

Title: Ship less JavaScript
Body: Every kilobyte must be downloaded, parsed and run. Audit dependencies, split by route, and prefer platform features (dialog, details, CSS) over libraries.

Title: Make it work without JavaScript first
Body: Server-rendered HTML with progressive enhancement is faster, more robust and more accessible. Add JavaScript for what genuinely needs it.

Title: Escape by default, sanitise on purpose
Body: Let your framework escape output. If you must insert HTML, sanitise it with a vetted library and add a Content Security Policy as a second line of defence.

Title: Pin and review dependencies
Body: Commit the lockfile, update on a schedule, and look at what a new package pulls in. Most front-end supply-chain trouble arrives through transitive dependencies.
